# Implementation status

Updated: 2026-10-10, public Keelmux v0.1.0 shipped; fuller communications and native supervision in progress.

[Keelmux v0.1.0](https://github.com/seanheiney/keelmux/releases/tag/v0.1.0) is public at exact source `60b8bc705b2636b087bf2fd872e976aa466ad3e9`. Both hosted source CI (macOS/Ubuntu race/vet, installer controls and actual archive smoke) and release CI passed. Four attested hosted archives are byte-identical to independently qualified local archives. Actual packaged acceptance passed macOS installer 16 groups, native Codex/Claude core 9 groups and private-entry 3 groups; Linux arm64 fixture runtime 8 groups with 11 CLI restarts, installer 16 groups and full source race/vet. The literal anonymous default one-line installer and owned default uninstall passed on macOS arm64 and nonroot Linux arm64 with native authentication, state and shell-profile sentinels preserved. See the [qualification index](https://github.com/seanheiney/keelmux/releases/download/v0.1.0/QUALIFICATION.json) for receipt hashes, archive digests and limits.

No model turn was submitted. macOS amd64/Linux amd64 remain build-only targets; Linux native-provider behavior and independently authenticated second servers remain unproved. Native credentials and permissions stay native. The release provides the terminal product, installer and operator documentation; it does not claim semantic channel dispatch or the full Bouncer MVP.

The owner requested interface refinement and thread bindings for Mattermost first, Slack and IRC. [PR #16](https://github.com/seanheiney/keelmux/pull/16) implements a separate durable authored-message service, immutable verified bindings, first-note snapshots, one claimed outbound attempt, exact delivery receipts, read-only reconciliation and a terminal inbox with frozen local reply intent. Scoped integrated race/vet and installer controls pass; independent Linux adapter fixtures pass. Clean worker source `ef39b9e` passed real owned Mattermost service 11 checks and source daemon/CLI 7 checks, including a lost actual acknowledgement, restart, no duplicate retry, disable and read-only reconciliation. The [receipt](../evidence/mattermost-owned-ef39b9e.json) qualifies that source/environment; final integrated and packaged reruns remain pending. Paginated inbox captures cover three terminal sizes and lost-response recovery. Customer Mattermost validation awaits a chosen destination and locally configured bot credentials. Messages, terminal observations, external chat delivery and model acceptance remain distinct.

The fuller release also includes managed local IRC and a commercial documentation site. Pinned Ergo provisioning, private loopback TLS/SASL, durable account/channel operations, human services accounts and exact-instance management are integrated. Source-built module race/vet and actual native-supervised persistence passed on macOS and isolated nonroot Linux arm64; see the [exact module receipt](../evidence/managed-ircd-native-accounts.json). Whole-product CLI/binding delivery and packaged checks remain active. The static documentation builder reads canonical guides and passes 10 source acceptance groups; actual Chrome evidence covers 55 responsive layout observations. GitHub Pages deployment remains pending. These are development capabilities under [release #17](https://github.com/seanheiney/keelmux/issues/17), not additions to the frozen v0.1.0 binaries.

On 2026-10-10 the owner explicitly removed mandatory tmux from the product architecture. A dedicated native supervisor stream now implements owned persistent PTYs/processes, private attachment, writer ownership, and restart reconciliation. Raw terminal output replay does not establish screen restoration; reconnect fidelity needs bounded parsed screen state and its own actual native evidence. The published tmux implementation remains an optional compatibility path. Native supervision is the integrated development default at `7f13006`, which passed full race tests and vet plus actual control-daemon SIGKILL/restart with tmux absent from PATH. Real helper transport tests cover Unicode, resize, keys, detach and caller restoration. Independent review fixes cover control framing, split graphemes and special-file refusal. Actual provider startup and final package/release qualification remain active.

Goldeneye Plane now tracks the project in the dedicated [Keelmux / KEELMUX board](https://plane.local.sean.network/goldeneye/projects/307ddb14-3cca-4188-b5b1-6299c45756ec). Eight issues and acceptance comments were created with HTTP 201 and verified by read-back. The [governing Page verification](../evidence/page-specification-verification.json) records exact body hashes for both linked specification documents. Historical paragraphs below retain their original exact-source scope.

The runnable core includes distinct stable identities and execution generations, a private Unix-socket daemon, serialized SQLite registry/journal, durable operation and lease identity, isolated tmux lifecycle, inherited-nonce linking, and a Bubble Tea switcher with remembered selection/groups/drafts. Missing runtimes are retained as missing; they are not automatically relaunched.

Source `b962535ec785db1243b032d573e43dc1dafc73d9` passed `make build check` on macOS arm64 with Go 1.26.6, tmux 3.7b, Codex 0.159.0, and Claude 2.1.296. Both real programs were entered from the TUI, received unsubmitted Unicode drafts, detached to the same selection, and survived a daemon restart with exact execution/runtime identity. The restart experiment exposed a leaked lock descriptor; the fix and an actual surviving-child regression are included in that SHA. [Core evidence](../evidence/2026-10-10-core-integration.md).

`4bf0162` adds a passing daemon race test for a delayed old stop after a synthetic replacement execution. It proves stale command rejection at that boundary, not a native continuation feature.

Independent acceptance of implementation `4bf01620db4fad2994d245212a4fab9c05571c8f` passed eight groups covering native keys/resize, TUI and daemon SIGKILL, dropped launch/attach/stop responses, writer competition, nonce rejection, ten-session switching, missing-runtime retention and journal recovery. Two real programs and eight explicit fixture sessions were used. No model turn was submitted, and native account/model/thread attribution remains unknown. [Independent core evidence](../evidence/2026-10-10-independent-native-core.md). This receipt does not certify later gateway or setup changes.

Owned provider discovery, selected user/project skill installation and crash-safe removal are integrated. Removal retains the intact bundle and independent receipts in a private archive; there is no automatic purge. Native Codex catalogue discovery and Claude's `/backplane` selector discovery have been observed without skill invocation or model turns. [Claude discovery and removal evidence](../evidence/2026-10-10-claude-project-discovery.md).

Implementation `4b36f4d773a31388c7ec8ade146eb1929a8d2a19` passed the full build, race tests and vet. Linux amd64 cross-compilation passed; Linux runtime behavior remains untested. Independent native acceptance in checkout `498abebbd69f99bff9bb7542bac37a6815d71c5d`, with an empty implementation diff to that frozen SHA, passed all eight local groups and both-provider gateway journeys. Codex and Claude received unsubmitted Unicode, resize and Escape, detached to the actual TUI with exact release, and reconnected to the same execution/PID/pane. The initial Codex timeout was a readiness predicate missing the observed `»` composer glyph; preserved receipts and the minimal harness correction qualify the rerun. [Current native evidence](../evidence/2026-10-10-independent-repaired-native.md).

The executable private gateway and client companion now retain original acquisition authority across lost acknowledgement and entry restart, hide home runtime locators, project current grants and keep healthy work usable when a home is unavailable. The reproduced authority, revocation and blocked-output defects were repaired. The adverse executable authority cases and all six gateway fixture groups passed against frozen `4b36f4d`; independent review found no remaining blocker in those repaired boundaries. [Gateway gate](../evidence/2026-10-10-gateway-hardened.md). One directory invocation returned healthy partial inventory in 3.009835 seconds while an owned home daemon was stopped, and the actual TUI still attached/input/detached at the healthy home. [Silent-home evidence](../evidence/2026-10-10-gateway-silent-home-latency.md). These are two execution homes on one physical computer. Independent second-server authentication/enrollment and the real SSH host/workspace selection remain pending.

Codex 0.159.0 also joined an owned idle app-server native thread from two initialized connections with zero turns. That feasibility result exposes no native writer lease; a scoped broker with durable writer fencing is the next semantic-adapter boundary. It is not an implemented semantic capability. [Zero-turn study](../research/CODEX_SEMANTIC_SPIKE.md).

The experimental Codex broker now has reviewed strict wire policy, durable shared authority and owned private Unix relay internals. Independent policy/relay acceptance passed 20 policy groups (312 nodes) plus 10 relay groups (27 nodes); authority handover/corruption and malformed-source defects were repaired. Integrated source `64e4211` passed `make build check`. On clean integrated source `d2e71aa693c3c04489e6439a576a2cb9b56d1298`, the controlled real native helper passed two fresh native resumes of the same durable legacy thread, retained primary/upstream channels through both detachments, and exact typed observation with zero model turns or final error counters. The final helper received independent source/receipt review. It advertises no semantic capability and remains separate from product `bpd` controller wiring. [Authority qualification](../evidence/2026-10-10-codex-authority.md), [native proof](../evidence/Codex-broker-native-2026-10-10.md), [integrated receipt](../evidence/Codex-broker-native-root-2026-10-10.json).

The owner authorized a public Keelmux product release on 2026-10-10, including a one-line installer and polished operational documentation. Naming searches found no exact public GitHub repository or npm/PyPI/crates.io/Homebrew package collision; this is not trademark clearance. The exact-source public release and anonymous default installation gates passed as recorded above.

Planned/not run: authenticated model-turn evidence, verified account/model/native-thread attribution, real second-server acceptance, semantic Mattermost/IRC delivery, shared repairs/meters, subscription routing, native continuity, and optional captains. The local terminal release does not complete those roadmap capabilities.
